g.data-tip: You type in the chat. The message starts one turn of this agent. If the agent is busy, its current turn is stopped first.

Per-agent schedule: loop, interval, daily, weekly, once or cron. Task mode Off = plain prompt. Force updateTodos = the agent must work through a todo checklist. Step workflow = runs a workflow with this agent as Runner.
Interbot message from another agent (POST /api/agents/<id>/interbot). Saved in both chats. The target agent must be idle.

http://127.0.0.1:8787, local only. GET /api catalog. GET /api/awareness is the same [App] map. GET /api/secrets lists names, GET /api/secrets/NAME returns a value (host decrypts secrets.bin). Snapshot, PATCH Soul, interbot, routines. Never decrypt secrets.bin yourself. No OS env for those keys.

svg.text: Host text ~4.7k · billed ~18k (SDK + MCP tools) + message

g.data-tip: One agent runs one turn at a time. Each agent has its own chat, settings, Soul, routines and workspace. It wakes up already knowing it is inside TecAdRiseBot.

Live capability map injected first every turn (also GET /api/awareness). Who you are, what this app can do, secrets.bin names, connectors on/off, MCP this turn, workspace, memory, skills, control plane. Trust it. Do not rediscover the host. Do not grep the app folder.

API keys and SSH keys in secrets.bin (Settings, API Keys). Host decrypts. Names are in [App]. Values: GET /api/secrets/NAME. Use in memory. Never print. Never write to Soul, memory.md, notes or disk. There is no OS env for these keys. Do not decrypt secrets.bin. Do not search ~/.ssh.
App-wide system prompt for every agent. Edit in Settings, System prompt. Click to open.
App-wide memory rules: shared memory folder plus private memory.md. Edit in Settings, System memory. Click to open.
Short description of how the app, roles and workflows work. Sent to every agent every turn. Click to open.
How to use the updateTodos / TodoWrite checklist tool. In workflow runner turns it is replaced by the step rules.
List of shared skills (folder with SKILL.md each, Settings, Computer). The agent reads a SKILL.md when it needs it.
This agent's sticky rules. Agent settings, General, Soul. The agent may PATCH /api/agents/id { instructions }. Do not put secrets in Soul.
[This turn]: agent name, id, workspace path, model. Settings, General for model, last-N chat, effort.

[MCP] names are a few hundred tokens. Cursor still sends every MCP tool schema plus built-in SDK tools (shell, read, grep, todos). That is most of the ~18k input on a hi with last messages = 0. Chat history is not in that bill.
The last N visible messages of this chat. Agent settings, General, Last messages (default 5). Tokens depend on message length.
The message that started this turn, attached files, and in workflow turns the step rules for the current step.
Every turn runs through the Cursor TypeScript SDK on this PC, with the agent workspace as working folder. Trust [App]. Do not rediscover the host.
g.text: Cursor SDK tools + MCP schemas are most of the bill

g.data-tip: App data, workspaces, agent id. The only place the agent writes files. memory.md is its private memory, uploads/ holds attached files. Never write secrets here.
App data, memory: index.md, notes/, log.md. Facts every agent should know. No secrets, keys or passwords.
Runner does one step at a time. The app runs hard checks. The Owner reviews steps (if on) and fixes failed steps, but never runs workflows. Max 3 owner fixes per run.
Settings, Connectors. Canva, Zoho Mail, Treg, GitHub, AgentMail, ElevenLabs, Context. Tokens stay in secrets.bin and attach as MCP tools when connected. On/off listed in [App] every turn.
Settings, API Keys. Stored in secrets.bin. Host decrypts. GET /api/secrets and GET /api/secrets/NAME. Not OS env. Not files on disk. Cursor SDK key is host-only.
